photos.title: File:01-21-2017 - Women's March on NYC looking up 5th Ave (10796).jpg
photos.author: Rhododendrites
photos.description: Looking up 5th Ave. from its intersection with 42nd St. at the Women's March on New York City on January 21, 2017. The march was to support equality and civil rights and to oppose the presidency of Donald Trump, whose inauguration was the day before. Hundreds of thousands of people marched from Dag Hammarskjold Plaza down 2nd Ave., west on 42nd St., then north on 5th Ave. to Trump Tower.
